lesson.opening: How can greater connection transmit both opportunity and disruption?

sections.heading: The institutional thread
sections.body:

Urban trades and political bargaining

Changing regional states

sections.heading: A model to test
sections.body: Do not make “connection” synonymous with improvement. Identify the institutions and routes through which goods, people, information, and disease moved.

sections.heading: Keep the question
sections.body: How can greater connection transmit both opportunity and disruption?

activities.prompt: Which happened first: “Chinggis Khan’s rise” or “Ottoman conquest of Constantinople”?

activities.prompt: “Greater trade necessarily made every population more prosperous.” — is that an event claim or an interpretation?
activities.hint: This universal causal claim requires evidence about distribution, disruption, and particular places.
